title: Scaffold Cargo package (Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/main.rs)
notes: Package name murmurhash; lib target for the hash function, bin target for the CLI. No external dependencies.

title: Port murmurhash3 core function to Rust
notes: Preserve the NON-STANDARD reverse chunk loop (for i = -l; i != 0; ++i over chunks = d + l*4). Use u32::to_le/from_le for htole32. Translate the fallthrough remainder switch (3->2->1) into a match with combined arms. Use wrapping_mul/wrapping_add for C-style overflow.

title: Port test.c vectors into #[cfg(test)] tests
notes: Must include "kinkajou" seed 0 -> 0xb6d99cf8 and "" seed 1 -> 0x514e28b7, plus all other vectors from test.c. Tests are the acceptance criteria.

title: Implement working CLI in src/main.rs
notes: Read stdin lines, hash each with optional --seed N (default 0), print decimal hash per line. Do NOT reproduce main.c bugs (malformed printf "%d" PRIu32, loop re-hashing buf instead of key).

title: Build and run cargo test until green
notes: cargo build then cargo test. Fix any overflow panics (wrapping ops) or value mismatches (check reverse chunk order and remainder fallthrough). Verify CLI manually with echo | cargo run.
